name: Stored maintenance evidence reader
packageArguments: String values encoded as base64 JSON: {"Package":"Storage","ReportId":"existing-report-identifier","Section":"Index","Ordinal":"0","Page":"0"}. Package Storage or Update. Storage ReportId is the exact timestamp-guid filename without .json; Update ReportId is the 32-character lowercase run-directory GUID. No arbitrary paths or latest-file selection. Sections: Index (property names and profile count), Profiles (one zero-based profile Ordinal), Snapshot (before/after), Policy (update before.policy), Scan, Actions, Errors, Guards, Evidence, Omissions. Other sections require Ordinal 0. Page is zero-based; each response contains up to 2048 bytes of base64-encoded UTF8 JSON plus SectionBytes, SectionSha256, PageCount, ReportBytes and ReportSha256. Concatenate decoded bytes in page order, verify section SHA256, then decode UTF8 and parse JSON. Verify all response report hashes match before combining pages; reports can change while maintenance runs. Existing reports only, at most 16 MiB before parsing; output at most 7500 UTF8 bytes. Trust checks refuse reparse ancestors and untrusted owned-path ACLs. A locked read handle refuses concurrent writers; no report, ACL or directory modifications. No diagnostics, repairs, scans, deletions, reboot, network or Ninja calls. Existing pinned runner stages toolkit/branding as usual; evidence transport itself opens no maintenance notification because it only reads an already collected report. Invalid requests exit 1 with a generic bounded error.
